run_labgraph_graph: run a Labgraph graph by passing a graph type class to the run entry point function
create_parallel_runner: create a ParallelRunner instance with a Graph and optional RunnerOptions to manage multi-process execution
run_parallel_runner: run the ParallelRunner to start all graph modules as separate processes with inter-process streams
review_parallel_runner_start_processes: review the ParallelRunner _start_processes method that serializes config, state, and streams to temp files for subprocesses
review_parallel_runner_get_class_module: review the ParallelRunner _get_class_module method that resolves the real module name for classes defined in __main__
